target.statement: Clean-label uncertainty-minus-random normalized balanced-accuracy AULC advantage of 1.45 percentage points on Banknote Authentication (95% CI 1.28 to 1.64)

compute.basis: Banknote is tiny (1372x4); the target needs 100 paired seeds x 2 strategies x 21 budgets of logistic regression with 3-fold CV over 7 C values plus a 500-tree random forest cross-fit per seed, all CPU-only sklearn work that finishes in well under an hour once the repo is installed.

blockers: Repo link in PDF is split across a line break ('hard-c' + 'ases-bad-labels'); must reconstruct the correct URL
Full 12,800-trial pipeline is much larger than the single target; must restrict to the Banknote clean-label component
Exact CI/p-value reproduction depends on the frozen seed rule and bootstrap implementation matching the repo
title: Hard Cases, Bad Labels: Testing Error Exposure and Error Location in Uncertainty Sampling Under Bounded Label Noise
